description: Turns sixteen gates from the patch into MIDI note on and off messages sent out to a device, for playing a drum machine from a sequencer

inputs.text: Rising past 2V sends a note on for the note printed in the cell above, and falling below 0.1V sends the note off; the velocity sent is 100

notes: nothing is sent until a MIDI device is chosen and each cell has been given a note
click a cell and type the note it should send; the grid starts at C2 in the lower left corner and climbs by a semitone across each row
the driver, device and channel are picked by left-clicking the three lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
menu: Velocity from gate amplitude — takes the velocity from the gate voltage, 10V giving 127, in place of the fixed 100
Reset MIDI (Panic) — sends a note off for every note this module has sent on, which clears a stuck note on the device
